verses.text: I am a priest of the Lord, and unto Him do I serve as a priest; and unto Him I offer the sacrifice of His thought.
For His thought is not like the thought of the age, nor the thought of the flesh, nor like them that serve according to the flesh.
The sacrifice of the Lord is righteousness and purity of heart and lips.
Present thy mind before Him without blemish; and let not thy heart oppress another heart, nor thy soul another soul.

section: Do Not Kill Your Own Soul
